Name: The Calming Laser
Description: Casts a laser beam that freezes enemies.

Name: The Glowing Confidence
Description: Speeds you up. Makes you invincible and attacks enemies touched. Paints the tiles you enter.

Name: The Burning Passion
Description: Casts a fireball. Would ignite flammable enemies.

Name: The Whisper of Love
Description: Casts a heart that mesmerises enemies, making it fight for you.
Default: i love you you love me

Name: The Rainbow of Hope
Description: Fires the trigger words character by character, turns black tiles to white.
Default: may the colour of my voice heal your pain

Name: The Mark of Sincere Words
Description:
Brands the trigger words on the map. 
The branded tiles slow enemies down, and block their bullets.
